title: Airbnb Prices & Availability Calendar — input

locationQueries.title: Places
locationQueries.description: Places as typed on Airbnb, e.g. ["Lisbon, Portugal"], ["Brooklyn, NY"], ["Algarve"]. Each returns up to maxListingsPerQuery listings with a price for the stay. A place Airbnb does not recognise is reported as an unknown_area status row and costs nothing (Airbnb would otherwise answer with listings from all over the world): write it as Airbnb spells it, with the country when ambiguous. Use for "Airbnb prices in <city>" and market runs; for exact listings use listingIds.
locationQueries.sectionDescription: Search places and/or paste Airbnb URLs (search results pages, listing pages) and/or listing ids. At least one.

startUrls.title: Airbnb URLs
startUrls.description: Airbnb search URLs or listing URLs, e.g. "https://www.airbnb.com/rooms/11562247". Search URLs retain their filters and guest counts; explicit checkIn/checkOut override URL dates. URL guest defaults are 2 adults, no children/infants/pets. Rows and optional details use that same effective context. Overlapping inputs deliver a listing once per run: first processed occurrence wins. Use separate runs for different stays/parties. Empty = use locationQueries or listingIds.

listingIds.title: Listing ids
listingIds.description: Numeric Airbnb listing ids, e.g. ["11562247", "45307024"] (the number in /rooms/<id>). Each is priced for the stay straight from its page and the row carries the full details (amenities, house rules, cancellation policy, host, price breakdown, available flag) at no extra charge. Use for "track these listings", your own portfolio or a comp set; filters and maxListingsPerQuery do not apply. Default empty.

checkIn.title: Check-in
checkIn.description: Check-in as "2026-12-10" or relative "30 days". Give both checkIn/checkOut or neither. Explicit dates override search-URL dates; otherwise a dated search URL keeps its stay, and undated inputs use the default displayed price. Reuse absolute dates to track the SAME stay; relative dates move with each run and track a constant lead time. Explicit past dates are rejected before charging. Pricing applies to the requested stay; calendarMonths starts in the current month.
checkIn.sectionDescription: Dates decide the price: with dates every listing row carries the nightly rate and total for exactly that stay and is billed only when Airbnb priced it; without dates every listing row carries Airbnb's default displayed price and is billed.

checkOut.title: Check-out
checkOut.description: Check-out date after checkIn: "2026-11-10" or relative: "33 days". Nights = checkOut minus checkIn, so checkIn "30 days" + checkOut "33 days" = a 3-night stay starting 30 days after each run. Every price in the run is for exactly this stay.

adults.title: Adults
adults.description: Adults in the party, 1 to 16, e.g. 2 (default 2). Passed to Airbnb as in the site's guest picker: prices depend on the guest count and the results are those the site shows for that party.

children.title: Children
children.description: Children aged 2 to 12, 0 to 10, e.g. 1 (default 0). Counted as guests for price and capacity, as on the site.

infants.title: Infants
infants.description: Infants under 2, 0 to 5, e.g. 1 (default 0). Passed to Airbnb exactly as the site's guest picker does.

pets.title: Pets
pets.description: Pets, 0 to 5, e.g. 1 (default 0). Passed to Airbnb as in the site's guest picker, so the results and prices are those a guest travelling with a pet sees. Use for "pet-friendly Airbnb in <city>".

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: ISO 4217 code for every price in the run, e.g. "EUR" (default "USD"). Any currency Airbnb supports: USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, AUD, CAD, BRL, MXN, CHF, SGD, INR, THB, AED, … Echoed on every row. When the user names no currency, pass the destination's ("EUR" for Lisbon, "MXN" for Mexico City).

locale.title: Language
locale.description: Airbnb locale for listing names, descriptions and reviews, e.g. "en" (default), "fr", "de", "es", "pt", "it", "ja". Prices and availability are not affected.

maxListingsPerQuery.title: Max listings per place
maxListingsPerQuery.description: Listings per place or search URL, 1-280; default 40. Caps Airbnb relevance-ordered results, not the cheapest listings. For a price comparison, sort delivered price_total or price_nightly_effective and label it a returned sample; a cap or priceMax does not prove a market-wide cheapest result. At most N x $0.005 listing charges per search, plus requested calendar/review events. Ignored for listingIds; duplicates are not billed again in one run.
maxListingsPerQuery.sectionDescription: Listing rows are always returned. Details are free; calendar months and reviews are priced per row and off by default.

includeDetails.title: Listing details
includeDetails.description: true = each listing row also gets description, amenities (name, group, available flag), house rules, cancellation policy, rating breakdown (cleanliness, accuracy, …), host (name, Superhost, verified, years hosting), person capacity, sleeping arrangement, highlights, the exact price breakdown for the stay, and an available flag with Airbnb's message when the dates are not available. No extra charge, one extra request per listing. Default false. Rows from listingIds always carry these.

calendarMonths.title: Calendar months
calendarMonths.description: 0 (default) skips the calendar. N requests N calendar months starting in the CURRENT month, not at checkIn (1-24). One calendar row per listing has a nested days array; join to listing rows on id. Billing is $0.002 per delivered month, not per row: 2 months = $0.004 per listing. Days contain availability and stay rules, not daily prices. occupancy_* counts unavailable days, including host blocks; it is not verified bookings. The run charge cap can shorten the calendar.

maxReviewsPerListing.title: Max reviews per listing
maxReviewsPerListing.description: 0 (default) = no reviews. N = up to N reviews per listing (maximum 200) as review rows at $0.003 each: rating, text, Airbnb's translation and original language, date, reviewer name and location, stay type, host reply. Use for "prices and the latest reviews together". For a rating filter, every review of a listing or more than 200, use kestrel/airbnb-reviews-scraper.

reviewsSort.title: Reviews order
reviewsSort.description: Which reviews come first when maxReviewsPerListing is set: "most_recent" (default), "highest_rated", "lowest_rated" (complaints first), "most_relevant" (Airbnb's own order). Ignored when maxReviewsPerListing is 0.

priceMin.title: Min price per night
priceMin.description: Lowest nightly price in `currency`, e.g. 80. 0 (default) = no minimum. Applied by Airbnb before maxListingsPerQuery, so filtered listings are never returned or billed. Place searches only; a pasted search URL keeps its own filters.
priceMin.sectionDescription: Filters apply to place searches; pasted search URLs bring their own.

priceMax.title: Max price per night
priceMax.description: Highest nightly price in `currency`, e.g. 200. 0 (default) = no maximum. Applied by Airbnb before maxListingsPerQuery, so listings above it are never returned or billed. Place searches only. Use for "Airbnb under 200 a night in <city>". Must be at least priceMin.

roomTypes.title: Room types
roomTypes.description: Only these room types, e.g. ["entire_home"] for whole places. Allowed: "entire_home", "private_room", "shared_room", "hotel_room". Empty (default) = any. Place searches only. Use for "entire homes in <city>", "private rooms in <city>".

minBedrooms.title: Min bedrooms
minBedrooms.description: Minimum bedrooms, e.g. 2. 0 (default) = any. Applied by Airbnb before the cap; place searches only. Use for "2-bedroom Airbnbs in <city>".

minBeds.title: Min beds
minBeds.description: Minimum beds, e.g. 3. 0 (default) = any. Applied by Airbnb before the cap; place searches only.

minBathrooms.title: Min bathrooms
minBathrooms.description: Minimum bathrooms, e.g. 2. 0 (default) = any. Applied by Airbnb before the cap; place searches only.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy settings. Airbnb accepts datacenter proxies for these calls: keep the default {"useApifyProxy": true}.

sessions.title: Parallel proxy sessions
sessions.description: Parallel proxy sessions (egress IPs), 1 to 16, e.g. 4 (default 4). Each is paced at perIp requests per second; more sessions = a faster run at the same cost.

perIp.title: Requests per second per IP
perIp.description: Requests per second per session, 0.1 to 3, e.g. 1 (default 1). Airbnb tolerated 1 per second in tests; raise it only when a run is slow and not being throttled.

description: Airbnb prices. Minimal input: {"locationQueries": ["Lisbon, Portugal"], "checkIn": "30 days", "checkOut": "33 days"}. One of locationQueries / startUrls / listingIds is required. Only listing rows are billed unless you set calendarMonths (per month) or maxReviewsPerListing (per review), both 0 by default; includeDetails is free. Without dates each listing row is billed at its default displayed price. Listing row keys: price_total (the stay total Airbnb displays for the dates, after discounts), price_nightly, price_nightly_effective (total ÷ nights), price_breakdown (with includeDetails: Airbnb's checkout line items), currency, rating, reviews_count, is_superhost, url.
